name: Miracle No-ton ~Negai o Uchikonde!~
original_name: みらくるのーとん 願いを打ちこんで！
source:
A fool's day themed typing game. Akira loses memory, but he still has the notebook that grants any wishes written. Conversation, event and attack modes are presented.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2020/07/vn-of-month-april-2008-gouen-no-soleil.html]vndbreview[/url]]
